bindings.qualification: Only explicit native parent rows (#PARENT#), identical recorded assay context, nonidentical valid parent/variant sequences, finite native fitness and resolved campaign reference/assay metadata. Parent replicates aggregate by median with every reference ID retained. Native fitness and derived change are assay-specific, not universal kcat/yield. Source collection/evidence separates LLM-extracted literature from the other experimental collections. DOI fields can reference a compiled data deposit, not an individual primary paper. Mutation strings preserved without claiming independently validated residue numbering. Derived partitions close reference-DOI and exact-parent-sequence components; this is not an independent homology holdout. Missing assay conditions remain unknown; within-source comparisons require audit before a frozen benchmark.
bindings.reference_evidence: Source EnzEngDB release experiments and metadata; no fabricated fitness labels. Delta is explicitly derived from native variant measurement and compatible parent reference(s).
